newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi shares drop in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Saudi shares drop in moderate trade.

text.p: Shares on Saudi Arabia's stock exchange dropped by just over one percent in the week to Thursday, figures from the Riyadh-based Bakheet Financial Advisors (BFA) showed on Saturday.
The index ended at 159.08 points, down from 160.87 a week earlier.
Services sector shares accounted for 35 percent of trading volume which BFA put at 3.22 million shares worth about 786 million riyals.
Of the 60 shares traded in the week, nine rose, 45 dropped and six were unchanged.
Al-Gassim Agriculture Co (GACO) was the week's star performer, gaining to 25 riyals from 23 riyals the previous week.
Amiantit lost eight percent to 104 riyals. Gizan Agriculture Co ended the week lower at 64 riyals from 69 riyals a week earlier.
